content.value_statement: Creator outreach loses context when pitches, follow-ups, and negotiations sit in separate notes. This skill turns campaign inputs into personalized outreach, follow-up cadences, negotiation scripts, and a pipeline tracker.
actual_capabilities: Creates primary, short DM, and formal email outreach versions for each target.
Builds a four-touch follow-up cadence with timing and channel guidance.
Drafts negotiation scripts for rate, scope, exclusivity, and common objections.
Produces a pipeline tracker with stages, next actions, dates, and health metrics.
Applies cold outreach copy rules for short, specific, and respectful first messages.
limitations: It does not send messages or connect to outreach tools by itself.
It depends on user-supplied or connector-supplied creator and campaign facts.
It does not finalize signed agreements or replace legal contract review.
It does not guarantee compliance with email, platform, or advertising rules.

use_cases.title: Prepare Creator Campaign Outreach
use_cases.description: Turn a campaign brief and creator list into personalized pitches, follow-ups, and tracking notes.

use_cases.title: Adapt Media or Launch Partner Pitches
use_cases.description: Use an approved angle and target list to create concise messages for journalists, hunters, or launch partners.

use_cases.title: Negotiate Creator Terms
use_cases.description: Prepare replies when a partner asks for a higher rate, different scope, exclusivity, or more details.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Creator Pitch
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for one creator and one campaign.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write outreach for @[handle] on [platform]. The campaign is [campaign], the product is [product], and the offer is [compensation].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Follow-Up Cadence
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for a creator who has not replied.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a follow-up sequence for @[handle]. We sent the first message on [date], the campaign is [campaign], and the next deadline is [date].

prompt_templates.title: Handle a Rate Negotiation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for an ask above budget.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me negotiate with @[handle]. Their ask is $[amount], our budget is $[amount], and the deliverables are [deliverables].

prompt_templates.title: Create an Outreach Tracker
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for managing multiple targets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an outreach pipeline for these targets: [list]. Include current stage, last contact date, next action, due date, and pipeline health.

output_examples.input: Pitch an eco-lifestyle creator for an organic skincare launch.
output_examples.output: The skill returns personalization points, a primary message, a short DM version, and a formal email version.

output_examples.input: Create follow-ups for a creator who has not replied after four days.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a respectful sequence with timing, shorter messages, alternate channels, and a final archive point.

output_examples.input: A creator wants more money than the campaign budget allows.
output_examples.output: The skill returns scope adjustment options, value exchange ideas, and ready-to-send negotiation replies.

best_practices: Provide verified recent content, audience details, budget, deliverables, and timeline before drafting.
Review every message for accuracy, consent, disclosure, and platform compliance before sending.
Record status, last contact date, next action, and final outcome after each outreach touch.
anti_patterns: Sending generic messages without a specific creator reference.
Following up daily or using pressure when the creator has not replied.
Inventing testimonials, performance data, client names, or content references.

faq.question: Can this skill send emails or DMs for me?
faq.answer: No. It creates messages and tracking artifacts. You decide whether to send them through your own tools.

faq.question: Does it work for media outreach?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide the target list, approved angle, and any embargo terms from your media workflow.

faq.question: Can it help with paid creator negotiations?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare the ask to your budget and draft replies for scope, value, and future opportunities.

faq.question: Does it verify creator audience data?
faq.answer: No. It uses the facts you provide or facts from optional connectors that you choose to use.

faq.question: Can it replace a contract workflow?
faq.answer: No. It can summarize agreed terms, but final agreements should use a contract workflow and legal review.

faq.question: How should I avoid spammy outreach?
faq.answer: Use specific personalization, limit follow-ups, make refusal easy, and follow all platform and email rules.
